caption: The drawing depicts a brass candlestick and includes three different representations of the object. To the right, there is a detailed colored illustration of the candlestick, which is gold or brass in color and features a hexagonal base, a columnar stem with multiple rounded and geometric segments, and a flat, circular top for holding a candle. To the left of this colored depiction, there is a line-drawn side elevation of the candlestick, showing its profile without color or shading. Below the side elevation, there is a line drawing representing the top view of the base, revealing its hexagonal shape with a circular center. Directly beneath these line drawings, there is a small scale marked in inches for size reference. The entire drawing is framed with a simple rectangular border, and the artist's signature "J. STALOFF" appears in the lower right corner. The background color is a light beige.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
